run_bench_vector_ops: run the FAISS vector operations benchmark script to measure inner product and L2sqr performance
run_fvec_inner_products_ny: run faiss fvec_inner_products_ny to compute inner products of one vector against many vectors
run_fvec_L2sqr_ny: run faiss fvec_L2sqr_ny to compute squared L2 distances of one vector against many vectors
run_swig_ptr: run faiss swig_ptr to get a SWIG pointer for a numpy array for FAISS C++ calls
run_omp_set_num_threads: run faiss omp_set_num_threads to set the number of OpenMP threads for parallel computation
